answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Wash maker hop kiln seal fermented in the brewhouse floor, priced at each hop kiln is a measured malt yield plus a guild signature, so a brewer must make. No bulk discount exists: 554 aliases need 554 proofs, and each proof is 96 POA the farm cannot reuse. One zenith per identity, one saffron per alias, one pulse per epoch: the farm must supply all three, every time. Honest work is cheap once; dishonest work is expensive forever.
